about: The rules of spec/engine/ai.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe server level load 0x574FB0: cmp byte [level+0x3AE

rules.title: The AI starts only for a level with HasAI, on the server

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe AI init 0x5B4B20 -> 0x5B33C0(difficulty); singletons at *(0x018903EC) +0x498 settings, +0x4A0 orders, +0x4A4 difficulty

rules.title: The AI's settings come from seven shared partitions

evidence.ref: every working AI level read lists mp_common's two PathfindingSettings in LevelData and every stock MP level has the array empty (STOCK_MP_AI_PLAN 12.1); the generator settings are found at LevelData+0x36C as an array of PathfindingSettings pointers; the set-up's per-type load was not traced instruction by instruction
PathfindingTypes infantry + vehicles on Napisal's ONS_MP_005GR, ONS_MP_002, ONS_MP_004, DICE's Xbox ONS_MP_002 and SP_004_B; empty on every stock MP level read

rules.title: One Kynapse world per pathfinding type the level lists

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe path-data set-up 0x00F209F1..0x00F20C8E (strings at 0x014A93D0 / 0x014A93E0, offsets passed from +0x1C / +0x18); probes at 0x00F20AD2, 0x00F20B48, 0x00F20BB0

rules.title: The path-data world is configured from the level's own assets at load

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe world capacity at 0x00F025EC (C7 46 08 01), registry refusal 0x0109E930; generator driver 0x00F299A0 with no caller in .text; Kaim::CMapBuilder licence request for feature CMapBuilder (error -1,359), 2026-10-14

rules.title: One runtime world, and no usable generator

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe go-to 0x0107FE80, Flat compute 0x0107F620 (false exits 0x0107F8E1, 0x0107F9B0, 0x0107FABE, 0x0107FB0D, 0x0107FC33, 0x0107FCB2, 0x0107FD6B), caller 0x010B1AB0, reader 0x010B2400; DataMode default 1 in the constructor 0x01080CC0

rules.title: A go-to is computed at once; "true" means the request was taken

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe ray / sphere cast 0xB145C0 (-> 0xB12F60, world vtable +0x34), capsule 0xB14640, point query 0xB145A0 (world vtable +0x3C); ray collector add-hit 0xB0D370, root collidables at +0x50 / +0x54; shape vtables 0x01454D14 terrain, 0x01483B38 objects, 0x01483378 soldiers

stock MP levels compared (all launch MP levels, identical on Xbox 360): HasAI false, no PathfindingTypes, no SpawnPointManager; path data only for the 13 campaign levels; MP_002: 1 AI spawner, disabled, 0 AreaOrder, 0 PatrolOrder

rules.title: Stock multiplayer levels carry no AI

evidence.ref: SSAiPlayer spawners enabled / named by an order: Napisal ONS_MP_005GR 24 / 17, ONS_MP_002 28 / 28, Xbox ONS_MP_002 78 / 78 (54 via squads), SP_004_B 91 / 91; orders 7, 41, 47, 182; SquadEntityData 0, 0, 17, 16

rules.title: What a working AI level has

evidence.ref: OPFOR's Onslaught play tests: DefaultSoldier bots aim and do not fire, DICE's grunt template fires; mp_005's package.mft block loads its own bundles and mp_common only

rules.title: Bots need a real AI template

evidence.ref: SSAiPlayer with SpawnDelay 15: Arica Harbor CQ 8 of 8, White Pass CQ 7 of 7, Nelson Bay Rush 11 of 13, Atacama CQ 7 of 8 (all enabled, Template null)

rules.title: The stock SSAiPlayer spawners are the human spawn points

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe game-event dispatcher 0x870070 (type at +0x88, 3 = player killed) -> 0x86DC90 (returns for a null victim at 0x86DCAE; scoring flag test 0x86DD97) -> kill scoring 0x86C070 (returns for an AI killer at 0x86C12D) -> award 0x86BE20

rules.title: Kills of bots score nothing offline without the scoring patch

evidence.ref: Kynapse answers a go-to from the graph of the path data's sectors (AI-KY-3); points not connected to the requester's node have no route; GR2's island and spawn tables show DICE's own campaign files with islands besides the main network

rules.title: A bot reaches only what the route graph connects to the main network

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe AI sphere query 0x577390 -> cull-tree walk 0x56C4E0, fault at level load (console Nelson Bay, 2026-10-29)

rules.title: The AI's sphere query walks the static cull tree (0x56C4E0)

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe Kynapse wait-ready 0x010074E0 (probe "AI: Kynapse wait-ready"; the crash reader's symbol table)

rules.title: The AI start can wait for a resource that never loads
An AI level needs the server's static-group physics

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe purecall handler 0x401090 from 0x01046AB3 (Kynapse release 0x01046AA0, from 0x010A248A in the container destructor 0x010A2450), at exit after a NavKit play test, 2026-10-19

rules.title: Unsorted path data crashes the game on exit (0x401090)
